ei.title: Chapter 5-16: Ego: The Barrier to Learning
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Many of us tend to have too much invested in our opinions of ourselves to see the world's feedback — the feedback we need to update our beliefs about reality. This creates a profound ignorance that keeps us banging our head against the wall over and over again. Our inability to learn from the world because of our ego happens for many reasons, but two are worth mentioning here. First, we're so afraid about what others will say about us that we fail to put our ideas out there and subject them to criticism. This way we can always be right. Second, if we do put our ideas out there and they are criticized, our ego steps in to protect us. We become invested in defending instead of upgrading our ideas.

"(깊은 무지는) 우리가 계속 벽에 머리를 부딪치게 한다"의 일부:
This creates a profound ignorance that __________ over and over again.

[조건] (1) against, banging, head, keeps, our, the, us, wall 을 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: keep + 목적어(us) + 현재분사(banging): ~가 계속 …하게 하다.
det.analysis: keeps(that절 동사) + us(목적어) + banging(현재분사) + our head + against the wall(전치사구). keep + O + -ing 구문.
det.tip: keep + O + -ing + 전치사구: keeps us banging our head against the wall

questions.wa: keeps us banging our head against the wall
accept: keeps us banging our head against the wall

questions.passage: Many of us tend to have too much invested in our opinions of ourselves to see the world's feedback — the feedback we need to update our beliefs about reality. This creates a profound ignorance that keeps us banging our head against the wall over and over again. Our inability to learn from the world because of our ego happens for many reasons, but two are worth mentioning here. First, we're so afraid about what others will say about us that we fail to put our ideas out there and subject them to criticism. This way we can always be right. Second, __________, our ego steps in to protect us. We become invested in defending instead of upgrading our ideas.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 [ ] 안의 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (정확히 12단어) (영어로)
"만약 우리가 우리의 생각을 드러내고 그것이 비판받는다면"
[ and / are / criticized / do / if / ideas / our / out / put / there / they / we ]

det.korean: if(만약) + we do put(강조의 do+동사원형) our ideas out there(생각을 드러내다) + and + they are criticized(비판받다, 수동).
det.analysis: 조건절 if + 주어 we + 강조 조동사 do + 동사원형 put + our ideas out there, and + they(ideas) are criticized(수동태). do+동사원형=강조.
det.tip: if + S + do + V원형 ... and + S + be + p.p.(수동)

questions.wa: if we do put our ideas out there and they are criticized
accept: if we do put our ideas out there and they are criticized

questions.passage: Many of us tend to have too much invested in our opinions of ourselves to see the world's feedback — the feedback we need to update our beliefs about reality. This creates a profound ignorance that keeps us banging our head against the wall over and over again. Our inability to learn from the world because of our ego happens for many reasons, but two are worth mentioning here. First, we're so afraid about what others will say about us that we fail to put our ideas out there and subject them to criticism. This way we can always be right. Second, if we do put our ideas out there and they are criticized, __________. We become invested in defending instead of upgrading our ideas.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]을 이용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

"우리의 자아가 우리를 보호하기 위해 개입한다":
__________.

[조건] (1) ego, in, our, protect, steps, to, us 를 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: our ego(주어) + steps in(개입하다) + to protect us(우리를 보호하기 위해).
det.analysis: 주어 our ego + 자동사구 steps in(개입하다) + 목적의 to부정사 to protect us. step in = 개입하다, 나서다.
det.tip: step in + to부정사(목적): our ego steps in to protect us

questions.wa: our ego steps in to protect us
accept: our ego steps in to protect us
